title: Prometheus metrics for every service

user_story.i_want: key pipeline metrics on /metrics for every service
user_story.so_that: I can see throughput, lag and errors at a glance

description: Use the metrics facade with metrics-exporter-prometheus. Metrics: ingest_records_total{result}, firehose_buffer_bytes{stream}, firehose_flush_total{trigger}, s3_put_seconds (histogram), scheduler_job_runs_total{job,status}, discovery_lag_seconds, worker_messages_total{role,result}, worker_records_total{role,data_type,outcome}, dlq_depth{queue}. Optional compose profile `observability` with Prometheus and Grafana plus one provisioned dashboard.

acceptance_criteria.then: Prometheus text containing its listed metrics is returned
none are high-cardinality (no event_id or file_id)
a dashboard shows records/sec and DLQ depth
